# GamesRadar+

> > GamesRadar+ is a comprehensive gaming media platform delivering news, reviews, guides, and coverage across all major gaming genres and platforms.

GamesRadar+ serves as a central hub for gaming journalism, featuring breaking industry news, in-depth game reviews, walkthroughs, and genre-specific coverage. The site covers major titles from franchises like The Elder Scrolls, Elden Ring, Pokemon, and The Last of Us, alongside emerging releases and developer insights.

## Key Topics

- Game Reviews
- Game News
- Gaming Guides
- RPG Games
- FPS Games
- Action Games
- Adventure Games
- PlayStation 5
- Industry News
- Game Releases
- Developer Interviews
- Gaming Platforms
- Elden Ring
- The Elder Scrolls
- Pokemon

## Core Gaming Hub

- [News on Games, by Genre](https://www.gamesradar.com/games): Main gaming news hub organized by genre with coverage of latest titles
- [Gaming News From Across the Platforms](https://www.gamesradar.com/platforms): Cross-platform gaming news covering Nintendo, Sony, and Microsoft releases

## Genre-Specific Coverage

- [RPG games - News, reviews, opinions and what to play now and next](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/rpg): RPG news, reviews, and recommendations with DLC and expansion coverage
- [News and Reviews from the Latest Action Games](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/action): Action game news and reviews covering latest releases and franchises
- [News and Reviews from the Latest Action RPG Games](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/action-rpg): Action RPG news and reviews covering Borderlands, Diablo, and Elden Ring
- [News and Reviews from the Latest FPS Games](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/fps): FPS game news and reviews covering Marathon, Counter-Strike 2, Overwatch
- [News and Reviews from the Latest Adventure Games](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/adventure): Adventure game news and reviews including Pokemon and Minecraft coverage
- [News and Reviews from the Latest Third Person Shooters](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/third-person-shooter): Third-person shooter news and reviews with guides and latest updates

## News, Reviews & Features

- [Games News](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/news): Latest games news covering releases, developer interviews, and industry updates
- [Games Reviews](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/reviews): Game reviews across multiple genres including RPG, FPS, and action-adventure
- [Games Features](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/features): In-depth game features, interviews, and editorial content on upcoming titles

## Platform-Specific News

- [PS5 News and Game Reviews](https://www.gamesradar.com/platforms/playstation/ps5): PS5 news and game reviews with announcements and latest releases

## Resources & Guides

- [Game Guides](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/guides): Game guides, walkthroughs, tips, and solutions for popular titles
